next_candidate.name: B1a_MKT50_v1
next_candidate.ticket_layer: 50/50 geometric pooling of model ticket probability and takeout-normalized market shape probability for 3rentan/2shatan

why_this_candidate: Burned A+B winner calibration showed B1a materially improved probability quality without a meaningful Top1 accuracy gain or loss versus Candidate A.
Burned A+B ticket diagnostics showed the dominant economic failure was severe model overconfidence in high-odds exact-order tickets where model and market disagreed strongly.
The next lineage therefore preserves the B1a winner layer and changes only the ticket economic-probability layer.
A fixed 0.50 pooling weight was preregistered rather than selected by an A+B tuning grid.
primary_scientific_gate: Untouched ticket log loss must strictly improve versus raw B1a baseline; calibration-tail error must also improve or be declared inconclusive if no hits occur.
economic_guardrail: ROI is secondary and cannot rescue failed calibration; sparse-hit ROI does not establish profitability.
next_action: Implement and self-test the preregistered B1a_MKT50_v1 transform using synthetic/result-free fixtures only.
Bind implementation hash to the preregistration.
Prepare an untouched-validation harness that cannot alter the 0.50 weight or competition threshold.
